title: VHPA — Helicopter Pilots Who Died in the Vietnam War (KIA index)
citation: Vietnam Helicopter Pilots Association, "Helicopter Pilots Who Died in the Vietnam War," online index with one page per man giving date, unit, aircraft, location and circumstances. https://www.vhpa.org/KIA/KIAINDEX.HTM
notes: A veteran-maintained roll of every Army helicopter pilot and crew member who died in the war, built from the DoD casualty file and unit records. Used 2026-09-05 to test Larry's statement that Lieutenant Hanna, a pilot in his unit, was killed in 1968 near Kontum flying for the 1st Cavalry. The index carries WO1 Gary W. Hanna, killed 31 January 1968 with B Troop, 1/9th Cavalry, 1st Cavalry Division, near Huế — see research/people/lt-hanna.md for why that man does not fit and what remains to check.
